confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded central estimates from search-result summaries of 2026 Belgrade cost-of-living and menu listings (Numbeo, Postopice.rs, Expatistan, Townleap and similar). The pages were not opened, and the sources disagree noticeably on inexpensive meals and cappuccino. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draft. Dinar prices were converted to USD at an approximate rate that was not separately sourced. wine_glass has the weakest direct evidence, so it is set modestly above the beer anchor (the local price relationship) and cross-checked against one hotel-bar report of a glass starting near 500 dinars. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 peak-season stay from general knowledge. No accommodation searches or listing checks were made, so they are the least certain. The FX rate came from search-result content for the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation, not an opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Belgrade-specific. Accommodation reflects a general regional view of Belgrade as a mid-priced Southeast/Central European capital in summer.
